mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) compress equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as investors shift from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% in 3 months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of triggered instances, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST > 1,050k) and retail sales (RSAFS > 430,000m) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years, or positive returns fail in >55% of interaction periods.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% quarterly) signals easing supply constraints, boosting manufacturing output and corporate profits, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of INDPRO > 1.5% periods, or Rank IC for INDPRO growth < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1,000k units (HOUST > 1,000k) indicates strong residential construction, correlating with rising consumer confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1,000k fails to produce positive 5-day returns in >55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Core inflation exceeding 3.5% annually (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) triggers monetary tightening expectations, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL > 3.5% periods, or average return not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Tight labor markets (UNRATE < 4.0%) fuel wage growth and consumer spending, driving corporate earnings expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >55% of UNRATE < 4.0% periods, or Rank IC for UNRATE < 4.0% < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) with stable rates (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) signals delayed monetary policy response, reducing real equity returns and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years, or negative returns fail in >55% of interaction periods.
